in_sanskrit.name: RaviKishan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: RaviKishan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ravi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', which means 'Sun'. Kishan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kishan', which means 'God of all pleasures'. Thus, RaviKishan can be interpreted as the Sun God or the God of all pleasures.
